#Read in the dataset with the soil PCA axes.



# Fit an SEM for both forest types together.

Keeping Elevation

```{r}
# looking at other interactions
mod6 <- lm(AnnualFlux ~ (F_type + SoilMoisture + FineRoots + soilPCA1 + EM_relabund + Temperature + Elevation)^3, 
            data=soilresp)
anova(mod6) 
check_model(mod6)

mod7 <- lm(AnnualFlux ~ ( SoilMoisture + FineRoots + soilPCA1 + EM_relabund + Temperature + Elevation)^3, 
            data=soilresp)
anova(mod7) 
check_model(mod7)

mod7a <- step(mod7)
anova(mod7a)
check_model(mod7a)
```
lm(formula = AnnualFlux ~ SoilMoisture + FineRoots + soilPCA1 + 
    EM_relabund + Temperature + Elevation + SoilMoisture:FineRoots + 
    SoilMoisture:soilPCA1 + SoilMoisture:EM_relabund + SoilMoisture:Temperature +

    FineRoots:Elevation + soilPCA1:EM_relabund + soilPCA1:Temperature +

# SEM all
```{r}

soil.sem<-psem(lm(AnnualFlux ~ SoilMoisture + FineRoots  , data = soilresp),
               #abiotic factors
               
               lm(SoilMoisture ~ Temperature ,
                  data = soilresp),
               lm(Temperature ~ Elevation,
                  data = soilresp),
               
               #biotic factors
               lm(FineRoots ~   EM_relabund     + Temperature,
                  data = soilresp),
               lm(EM_relabund ~  SoilMoisture  + Elevation,
                  data = soilresp),
               soilresp)


#call summary
summary(soil.sem)
rsquared(soil.sem)
anova(soil.sem)
#check residuals:


sim.residuals <- simulateResiduals(soil.sem[[4]])
plot(sim.residuals)


#There still seems to be some heteroscedasitcity in the residuals. get coefficients in table.


soil.sem.coefs <- coefs(soil.sem,
      standardize = "scale",
      standardize.type = "latent.linear",
      test.statistic = "F",
      test.type = "II",
      intercepts = FALSE)
soil.sem.coefs
knitr::kable(soil.sem.coefs)


#Call missing paths:


dSep(soil.sem, .progressBar = F)
knitr::kable(dSep(soil.sem, .progressBar = F))


#Write function to plot the SEM:


plot.psem <- function(x, return=FALSE,
                      node_attrs = data.frame(shape = "rectangle", color = "black",
                                              fillcolor = "#40663F",
                                              height=0.3, width=0.8, margin = 0.4),
                      edge_attrs = data.frame(style = "solid", color = "black"),
                      ns_dashed = T, alpha=0.05,
                      show = "std", digits = 4, 
                      scale = 'std', dir_col=F, sign_level=T,
                      add_edge_label_spaces = TRUE, ...
){
  
  #get the coefficients table
  ctab <- coefs(x)
  ctab$Response <- as.character(ctab$Response)
  ctab$Predictor <- as.character(ctab$Predictor)
  colnames(ctab)[9]<-"sign"
  
  
  #make a nodes DF
  unique_nodes <- unique(c(ctab$Response, ctab$Predictor))
  nodes <- create_node_df(n = length(unique_nodes),
                          nodes = unique_nodes,
                          type = "lower",
                          label = unique_nodes)
  nodes <- cbind(nodes, node_attrs)
  nodes[] <- lapply(nodes, as.character)
  nodes$id <- as.numeric(nodes$id)
  
  #make an edges DF
  edges <- create_edge_df(
    from = match(ctab$Predictor, unique_nodes),
    to = match(ctab$Response, unique_nodes))
  
  edges <- data.frame(edges, edge_attrs)
  edges[] <- lapply(edges, as.character)
  edges$id <- as.numeric(edges$id)
  edges$from <- as.numeric(edges$from)
  edges$to <- as.numeric(edges$to)
  if(ns_dashed) edges$style[which(ctab$P.Value>alpha)] <- "dashed"
  if(show == "std") edges$label = round(as.numeric(ctab$Std.Estimate), digits = 2)
  if(show == "unstd") edges$label = round(as.numeric(ctab$Estimate), digits = 2)
  if(add_edge_label_spaces) edges$label = paste0(" ", edges$label, " ")
  if(sign_level) edges$taillabel <- as.character(ctab$sign)
  if(scale == "std") edges$penwidth = (1+abs(as.numeric(ctab$Std.Estimate)))^2
  if(scale == "unstd") edges$penwidth = (1+abs(as.numeric(ctab$Estimate)))^2
  if(dir_col) edges$color[which(ctab$Std.Estimate<0)] <- "blue1"
  
  
  #turn into a graph
  sem_graph <- create_graph(nodes, edges, directed=TRUE)
  
  if(return) return(sem_graph)
  
  render_graph(sem_graph, ...)}


#Plot the SEM.


SEMallplot <- plot.psem(soil.sem, dir_col = T)
SEMallplot


```

Write function to plot the SEM:

```{r SEMallplotfnc}
plot.psem <- function(x, return=FALSE,

){
  
  #get the coefficients table
  ctab <- coefs(x)
  ctab$Response <- as.character(ctab$Response)
  ctab$Predictor <- as.character(ctab$Predictor)
  colnames(ctab)[9]<-"sign"
  
  
  #make a nodes DF
  unique_nodes <- unique(c(ctab$Response, ctab$Predictor))

                          nodes = unique_nodes,

  if(show == "unstd") edges$label = round(as.numeric(ctab$Estimate), digits = 2)
  if(add_edge_label_spaces) edges$label = paste0(" ", edges$label, " ")
```

# Separate the dataset by forest type.

```{r}
soilresp1<-soilresp%>%filter(F_type=="Primary")
soilresp2<-soilresp%>%filter(F_type=="Secondary")
```

## SEM for Primary forest.

```{r SEMog}
og.sem<-psem(lm(AnnualFlux ~ SoilMoisture   , data = soilresp1),
               #abiotic factors
               
               lm(SoilMoisture ~ FineRoots,
                  data = soilresp1),
               
               
               #biotic factors
               lm(FineRoots ~   EM_relabund     + Temperature,
                  data = soilresp1),
               lm(EM_relabund ~   Elevation + SoilMoisture,
                  data = soilresp1),
               soilresp1)

#call summary
summary(og.sem)
rsquared(og.sem)
anova(og.sem)
sim.residuals1 <- simulateResiduals(og.sem[[4]])
plot(sim.residuals1)

plot.psem(og.sem, dir_col = T)

summary(lm(AnnualFlux ~ SoilMoisture   , data = soilresp1))
```

Check the model fit with the simulated residuals.

```{r SEMogResid}
resp.sem1<-psem(lm(AnnualFlux ~ FineRoots + SoilMoisture,
                      data = soilresp1),
                   lm(FineRoots ~   EM_relabund + SoilMoisture + Temperature ,
                      data = soilresp1),
                   lm(SoilMoisture ~   EM_relabund + Elevation,
                      data = soilresp1),
                   lm(EM_relabund ~   Elevation ,
                      data = soilresp1),
                   soilresp1)


#call summary
summary(resp.sem1)
sim.residuals1 <- simulateResiduals(resp.sem1[[4]])
plot(sim.residuals1)
```

The fit looks good! Get coefficient tables

```{r SEMogCoef}
coefs(resp.sem1,
      standardize = "scale",
      standardize.type = "latent.linear",
      test.statistic = "F",
      test.type = "II",
      intercepts = FALSE)

knitr::kable(coefs(resp.sem1,
      standardize = "scale",
      standardize.type = "latent.linear",
      test.statistic = "F",
      test.type = "II",
      intercepts = FALSE))
```

Call the missing paths.

```{r SEMogmiss, warning=TRUE}
dSep(resp.sem1, .progressBar = F)
knitr::kable(dSep(resp.sem1, .progressBar = F))
```

There is no missing paths in this model. Plot the model with different
arrow colors for estimate direction.

```{r SEMogplot}
plot.psem(resp.sem1, dir_col = T)

```

## SEM for Secondary forest

```{r SEMsf}
resp.sem2<-psem(lm(AnnualFlux ~ Elevation + FineRoots + SoilMoisture  ,
                      data = soilresp2),
                   lm(FineRoots ~   AMabun_BA + SoilMoisture + Elevation ,
                      data = soilresp2),
                   lm(SoilMoisture ~ Elevation + AMabun_BA ,
                      data = soilresp2),
                   lm(Temperature ~ Elevation ,
                      data = soilresp2),
                   lm(AMabun_BA ~  Elevation  + Temperature,
                      data = soilresp2),
                   soilresp2)


#call summary
summary(resp.sem2)
summary(lm(AnnualFlux ~ FineRoots  , data = soilresp2))
```

Check the model fit.

```{r}
sim.residuals2 <- simulateResiduals(resp.sem2[[4]])
plot(sim.residuals2)
```

There seems to be some heterogeneity in the residuals, however, it
doesn't look too bad. Get the Coefficients in a table:

```{r SEMsfcoefstable}
coefs(resp.sem2,
      standardize = "scale",
      standardize.type = "latent.linear",
      test.statistic = "F",
      test.type = "II",
      intercepts = FALSE)

knitr::kable(coefs(resp.sem2,
      standardize = "scale",
      standardize.type = "latent.linear",
      test.statistic = "F",
      test.type = "II",
      intercepts = FALSE))
```

See if there are any missing paths:

```{r SEMsfmisscoeftable}
knitr::kable(dSep(resp.sem2, .progressBar = F))
dSep(resp.sem2, .progressBar = F)
```
plot the initial one to compare:


Annual Flux doesn't seem to be independent from PCA2. We update the psem
and check coefficients and missing paths again.

```{r}
resp.sem2b<-update(resp.sem2, AnnualFlux ~ FineRoots + Temperature )
```

Coefficients:

```{r}
coefs(resp.sem2b,
      standardize = "scale",
      standardize.type = "latent.linear",
      test.statistic = "F",
      test.type = "II",
      intercepts = FALSE)
```

Temperature is not a significant predictor for Annual flux. Missing paths:

```{r}
knitr::kable(dSep(resp.sem2b, .progressBar = F))
```

Now also soil PCA3 is significant. we update again.

```{r}
resp.sem2b<-update(resp.sem2b, AnnualFlux ~ FineRoots + SoilMoisture +Elevation )

```

Check coefficients.

```{r}
coefs(resp.sem2b,
      standardize = "scale",
      standardize.type = "latent.linear",
      test.statistic = "F",
      test.type = "II",
      intercepts = FALSE)
```

soil PCA3 and soilPCA2 is not a significant predictor for Annual flux.
Missing paths:

```{r}
knitr::kable(dSep(resp.sem2b, .progressBar = F))
```

Now soilPCA1 also seems to be a missing predictor, we update again and
check the model

```{r}
resp.sem2b<-update(resp.sem2b, AnnualFlux ~ FineRoots + soilPCA2 +soilPCA3 + soilPCA1)

```

Check coefficients.

```{r}
knitr::kable(coefs(resp.sem2b,
      standardize = "scale",
      standardize.type = "latent.linear",
      test.statistic = "F",
      test.type = "II",
      intercepts = FALSE))
```

The P-values went down for all soilPCA axes, but they still are not a
significant predictor for Annual flux. Missing paths:

```{r}
knitr::kable(dSep(resp.sem2b, .progressBar = F))
```

Now total basal area also comes on as a missing path.

```{r}
resp.sem2b<-update(resp.sem2b, AnnualFlux ~ FineRoots + soilPCA2 +soilPCA3 + soilPCA1+total_BA)

```

Check coefficients.

```{r}
knitr::kable(coefs(resp.sem2b,
      standardize = "scale",
      standardize.type = "latent.linear",
      test.statistic = "F",
      test.type = "II",
      intercepts = FALSE))
```

The P-values went down for all soilPCA axes, and total_BA and most of
them are borderline significant, except soilPCA2. Missing paths:

```{r}
knitr::kable(dSep(resp.sem2b, .progressBar = F))
```

There's no more missing paths. checking the model fit again.

```{r}
sim.residuals2b <- simulateResiduals(resp.sem2b[[4]])
plot(sim.residuals2b)
```

It doesn't look very different from the first one. Plot the model, we
rewrite the function for the color of the boxes.

```{r SEMsfplotfnc}

  unique_nodes <- unique(c(ctab$Response, ctab$Predictor))

                          nodes = unique_nodes,
                          type = "lower",
                          label = unique_nodes)

  #make an edges DF

  if(ns_dashed) edges$style[which(ctab$P.Value>alpha)] <- "dashed"
  if(show == "std") edges$label = round(as.numeric(ctab$Std.Estimate), digits = 2)

  if(sign_level) edges$taillabel <- as.character(ctab$sign)
```

# Correlation matrix plot 

Select traits to include 

```{r correlogram}
# corrplots
#require(GGally)
names(soilresp)
# Check correlations (as scatterplots), distribution and print corrleation coefficient 
p_pairs_all <- ggpairs(soilresp, columns = c(2,12,11,13:14,36,40), ggplot2::aes(colour=F_type),
                   progress=FALSE,
                   diag = list(discrete="barDiag", 
                               continuous = wrap("densityDiag", alpha=0.5 )),
                   lower = list(continuous = wrap("smooth", alpha = 0.3))) + theme_bw()
# Change color manually.
# Loop through each plot changing relevant scales
for(i in 1:p_pairs_all$nrow) {
  for(j in 1:p_pairs_all$ncol){
    p_pairs_all[i,j] <- p_pairs_all[i,j] + 
        scale_fill_manual(values=c("#40663F", "#D58A60")) +
        scale_color_manual(values=c("#40663F", "#D58A60"))  
  }
}
p_pairs_all
```
